0022600107.text: The Houston Rockets (1-0, 1st in the Southwest and 3rd in the West) visit the Atlanta Hawks (2-0, 1st in the Southeast and 1st in the East), who have both of their wins on the road. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Rockets won both meetings in 2025-26, most recently 117-95 in Houston on March 20, 2026. Reed Sheppard is out for Houston with a knee bruise, averaging 3.0 points and 15.8 minutes this season after 13.5 points and 26.2 minutes last season, while Atlanta is without Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture).
